game_concept: A puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel, a frosted chapel: the sled courier must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Boolean Guards: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel: a frosted chapel
core_gameplay_loop: In Frosted Chapel, repeat each round: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the guards value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the sleigh using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the sleigh is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Boolean Guards
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Guards' (Week 6 slot 10), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Frosted Chapel'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guards changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Frosted Chapel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The sleigh reached with actions_used <= 18.
